description: This file defines the HelpService class in the OrangeHRM Help plugin, responsible for managing help configurations and processing help-related actions such as obtaining redirect URLs and validating URLs within the Help plugin module.

classes.name: HelpService
classes.description: Service class providing help configuration and processing functionalities for the Help plugin.

methods.name: getHelpConfigService
methods.description: Returns the HelpConfigService instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getHelpProcessor
methods.description: Returns the HelpProcessor instance, creating it dynamically based on configuration if not already instantiated.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Delegates to HelpProcessor to get redirect URL for a given help label.

methods.name: getDefaultRedirectUrl
methods.description: Gets the default redirect URL from the HelpProcessor.

methods.name: isValidUrl
methods.description: Checks if the base help URL from config is a valid URL.
